verdict.rationale: Ramp's own QuickBooks integration page documents real-time sync of "accounting fields, transactions, reimbursements" and more, plus a reconciliation tool. Ramp also says receipts are "coded to the correct GL account" and that it handles multi-entity transaction sync. For NetSuite and Xero, however, the integration evidence only describes vendor-bill workflows, not transaction sync. Nothing explicitly shows finance-controlled mapping of GL account, class, or department. missing for 10: documented transaction sync to NetSuite and Xero, explicit user-configurable GL/class/department mapping rules, class mapping evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
